verdict.score_rationale: The board is parseable but lands at the 5 anchor because small text, sprawling recovery routes, and several perimeter-scale detours make the central flow slow to follow at arm's length.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes and chips have clear local space, but the overall scale makes their text small, and several labels sit amid long vertical or horizontal edge traffic.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Six numbered regions clearly establish functional ownership, though the large recovery region overlaps the visual territory of execution and capacity flows.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Arrowheads, colors, and dashed styles help, but multiple dashed perimeter mega-detours, long return paths, and a clipped right-edge label require sustained tracing.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: The main stages, cache path, retries, failures, and accounting are represented, but the broad canvas and inter-region loops prevent the primary topology from reading at a glance.
